latestVersion.changelog:
v1.0.0 — Initial release with comprehensive local business intelligence and lead prioritization:

- Scrapes all local businesses in any location and category, filtering by criteria like chain status and review count.
- Runs a full health diagnostic per business (website, SEO, reviews, social, Google listing, more).
- Calculates estimated monthly revenue at risk and assigns an opportunity score to each business.
- Ranks leads by urgency and opportunity, highlighting those most in need of your service.
- Generates tailored outreach messages for each lead, including exact gaps and potential revenue impact.
- Produces a local market opportunity video using InVideo AI.
- Powered by Apify, InVideo AI, and Claude AI for data gathering, analysis, and content production.
